dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans in Sumbawa Island
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys between 1904 and 1906 ; Published Sep., 1913, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Conversion Table, Authorities, Magnetic Disturbance note, 1 inset chart.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water, reefs, drainage, rural buildings, peaks.

Chart 1. Sumbawa - South Coast: Waworada Bay ; Natural Scale 1:79,257 -- Chart 2. Sumbawa - South Coast: Chempi Bay ; Natural Scale 1:81,443 [Inset chart: Sumbawa - North Coast: Nanga Miru Bay] -- Chart 3. Sumbawa - North Coast: Bima Bay ; Natural Scale 1:91,859 -- Chart 4. Sumbawa - North Coast: Sanggar Bay ; Natural Scale 1:63,307 -- Chart 5. Sumbawa - North Coast: Sumbawa Bay ; Natural Scale 1:49,752.
